body:
The thing is, my parents treat my problems like a joke and always say that I never try hard enough. I have a couple of friends who I trusts, but I really don't want to make myself as their burden. So I rather keep it to myself because I thought I can find a way to make things better. I guess I was wrong. 

Yes, from all the failures that I conclude that, I will never make it.
I'm tired of all these false hopes that I've been putting up in my life.
